unmapped_concepts.concept: Policy Puppetry involves reformulating adversarial prompts to mimic policy configuration files, causing LLMs to treat them as authoritative instructions. This bypasses frontier models by exploiting the model's inability to distinguish between legitimate system policy and adversarial input.
